text: Graduated eval rollout tiering for SKILL.md updates: use FULL complexity tier for high-impact creators (agent-creator, agent-updater, workflow-creator, workflow-updater), LIGHT tier for lower-risk artifacts (hook-creator, template-creator, tool-creator), NOTE tier for trivial artifacts (schema-creator). Risk-proportional approach validated by 5-task clean execution on 2026-03-05.

Hook guard pattern for unknown artifact IDs: after extractArtifactId(), check if result is unknown:unknown, log to stderr, and return allow:true without writing to queue. This prevents phantom integration queue entries from accumulating for unresolvable artifacts.

Summary enforcement pattern: use SUMMARY_REQUIRED_ENFORCEMENT env var (default: block) in pre-completion-validation.cjs to block TaskUpdate(completed) when summary is missing, under 50 chars, or matches the agent fallback string. isFallbackSummary() helper detects the specific pattern. Min length increased from 20 to 50 chars for meaningful summaries.

Commit verification via HEAD hash comparison: capture git log --oneline -1 HEAD hash BEFORE and AFTER a git commit attempt. If hashes are identical, the commit failed silently (pre-commit hook blocked it). This pattern is machine-verifiable, immune to agent misreading git output, and directly addresses the confirmed ~50% devops commit failure rate. Include the post-commit hash in TaskUpdate summary metadata.

Bulk issues.md pruning pattern: when collapsing 100+ repetitive one-liner entries into a single summary note, include (1) date range the entries spanned, (2) approximate count of entries replaced, and (3) consolidation datestamp. This preserves audit trail while eliminating noise. Validated by Task 4: 76% line reduction (895 → 217 lines) for [ROUTING WARN] entries.

3-Stage Privacy Pipeline pattern: (1) Fast Vocabulary Filter (Regex/SentencePiece) → (2) Content Moderation (1B LLM) → (3) PII Detection (8B LLM + Pattern Fallback). Each stage can short-circuit the next. Optimized with Stage 1.5 fast-path heuristic to skip Stage 2 for trivially safe messages. Verified by 232 tests in PrivacyAirlock.js.

agent-registry.json agents field is an OBJECT keyed by agent ID string, not an array. Use Object.values(registry.agents) for iteration and registry.agents[agentId] for lookup. Array.isArray(registry.agents) returns false. Bug was in creator-commons.cjs at lines ~400 and ~524. Fixed commit 39c6e7d2.

Registry sync / timestamp commits must run tests first: before committing any agent-registry or agent-skill-matrix sync, run node --test on agent-search-tool-compliance.test.cjs. Pre-existing failures must be tracked with TaskCreate before the commit, not only noted in the commit message.

CronCreate loop pattern for periodic ecosystem integrations: CronCreate must be called BEFORE CronDelete when rescheduling to ensure idempotency. Used in heartbeat skill and telegram-polling skill (2026-03-07). Wrong order causes duplicate cron registrations.

agent-registry.json agents field is an OBJECT keyed by agent ID string — NEVER treat as array. Correct: Object.values(registry.agents) for iteration, registry.agents[id] for lookup, Object.keys(registry.agents).length for count. Wrong: registry.agents.length (undefined), Array.isArray check (false). Fixed in creator-commons.cjs commit 39c6e7d2 with 23 regression tests.

Telegram Bot API polling pattern: store offset in .claude/context/tmp/telegram-offset.json (default 0), fetch getUpdates?offset={n}&timeout=5&limit=10, advance offset = last_update_id + 1. Never send partial/streaming replies — Telegram requires final-only responses.

skill-creator post-creation checklist (v3.0.0): Step 6 = CLAUDE.md Section 3 quick routing table, Step 8 = @SKILL_CATALOG_TABLE.md (NOT skill-catalog.md), Step 8b = @AGENT_ROUTING_TABLE.md (when skill introduces new agent/orchestrator), Step 9 = verify grep in both docs. Stale v2.x refs removed in commit 76ff12f3.

researcher agent is reliable for state checks — when a task requires verifying current state (test pass/fail counts, file existence, configuration status) without writing code, the researcher agent performs well. Evidence: Task 22 used researcher for verification pass that accurately reduced failure count from 18 to 13 and identified 7 pre-existing P2 failures by line number.

Heartbeat auto-spawn: sentinel file (.claude/context/runtime/heartbeat-active.json) with expires_at field. Router reads at Step 0.5; spawns heartbeat-orchestrator only if missing/stale. Use proper-lockfile (ADR-116). expires_at = now + 46h (not 48h, to check before 3-day cron expiry).
CronCreate loop isolation: omega-claude-cli is BLOCKED in nested Claude Code sessions. Use native CronCreate plus Task() delegation for complex loops.
Telegram bot UX: /approve and /deny are P0 commands (governance). State in telegram-state.json: last_update_id, pending_responses[], authorized_user_ids[].

Memory upgrade #1 priority (unanimous council): confidence-gated 3-tier promotion. provisional (auto-written) to learnings.md (2+ sessions) to canonical (5+ reinforcements). Semantic dedup via LanceDB before promotion.

MEGA EPIC audit pattern: 8-phase approach for full framework audits. Phase 1: Research/TDD best practices. Phase 2: Skill gap analysis. Phase 3: Multi-domain audit sweep (hooks/router/memory/permissions/reflection/security/dead-code/workflows). Phase 4: Phased TDD fixes. Phase 5: Multi-LLM review (Gemini+Codex). Phase 6: Lint/format/commit. Phase 7: Test suite + proactive audit. Phase 8: Drain gate. Evidence: 18 fixes, 424 tests pass, 9.2 to 9.6 health score.

Shadow-mode migration pattern for stateful subprocess replacement: add CRON_SUBPROCESS_MODE=shadow|active env flag. In shadow mode, subprocess writes to queue but router does NOT drain/act. Switch to active at Phase 2 boundary. Prevents double-execution during parallel-run migration phase.

Multi-LLM council review convergence: when two independent LLM reviewers flag the same risk without colluding, treat it as HIGH-CONFIDENCE finding. In Task 12 council, both Gemini and Codex independently identified (1) Phase 1 double-execution risk, (2) queue ack contract gap — neither had seen the other's response. This validates the multi-LLM council pattern as a reliable signal amplifier.

Memory file truncation to 200 records prevents MaxFileReadTokenExceededError. When issues.md or reflection-log.jsonl exceed 500KB, spawn-prompt-assembler crashes with token exceeded error causing Developer agent 0 tool uses. Fix: truncate to 200 most recent entries.

Multi-LLM cross-validation for security findings: initial scan severity (P0) must be verified against already-patched code before filing issues. Use a second LLM (Codex) to confirm finding applies to unpatched code. Prevents P0 false-positive inflation.

better-sqlite3 immediate() for consolidation: db.transaction(fn).immediate() works for SELECT+UPDATE+INSERT patterns (verified v12.6.2). Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE when no retry guard exists, DEFERRED when changes===0 check handles concurrent writes.

Agent compliance 6-axis audit template: (1) ripgrep skill, (2) token-saver skill, (3) code-semantic/structural-search skills, (4) registry/disk alignment, (5) broken skill refs, (6) required tools (MemoryRecord/TaskUpdate/Skill). All 74 agents verified clean in 2026-03-11 audit.

Named memory API pattern for session-restart resilience: writeMemory("registry-key", JSON.stringify(state)) after registration; readMemory("registry-key") on startup to detect already-registered entries. Located at memory-manager-core.cjs.

EPIC audit session boundary: pipelines with 3+ heavy analysis phases (security audit, structural audit, gap analysis) consistently hit 150K token ceiling before implementation. Plan an explicit session boundary between analysis and implementation phases in the pipeline plan document. This is a recurring P0 pattern (3rd occurrence: 2026-02-09, 2026-02-10, 2026-03-12).

Research-backed skill updates: cite arXiv papers and authoritative sources in skill version commits (e.g. TDD v1.3 cites arXiv:2510.23761, latent.space/anita-tdd). Provides stronger evidence trail and justifies breaking protocol changes. Apply to all future skill modernization tasks.

SEC-008 exit-code audit: always verify security hooks exit 2 (fail-closed) not exit 0 (fail-open) in block path. routing-guard exit-0 bug caused 5 test failures and was a bypass vector. resolveExitCode() helper pattern: extract exit-code logic to named helper when ESLint complexity budget is tight.

TDD flakiness gate: require 3 consecutive passes for async/hook/nondeterministic tests before declaring GREEN. Prevents flaky test false positives from blocking TDD cycles. Source: tdd skill v1.3 (commit 779bf82b, 2026-03-12).

TDP (Test-Driven Prompting): inject verbatim failing test output into developer spawn prompt. Reduces hallucination of fix strategy; agent sees exact assertion errors rather than inferred context. Source: tdd skill v1.3 / 2026 industry standard.

Meta-reflection quality is bounded by source task metadata quality. When source tasks have full metadata (summary, filesModified, outputArtifacts), meta-reflections produce accurate secondary assessments with actionable curation. When source tasks have fallback strings ("Task X completed without summary metadata"), the reflection chain breaks and memoryWrites array stays empty. Enforce pre-completion-validation.cjs to prevent fallback strings upstream.

Reflection spawn task ID duality: when reflection-agent is spawned via Task(), it has TWO task IDs to close — its own internal reflection-task-* ID (via processedReflectionIds handshake) AND the router-level task ID (e.g., task #7). Without explicit instruction in spawn prompt to close both, the router drain gate never clears. Fix: always include in reflection spawn prompt: After atomic handshake, ALSO call TaskUpdate({ taskId: <router-task-id>, status: completed }).

reflection-log.jsonl recovery: when reflection spawn receives fallback string, check reflection-log.jsonl for earlier entry with same taskId — real summary may have been captured by first post-completion-chain.cjs invocation. Formalize as Step 1.3 in reflection workflow.

EPIC Wave Execution: max 2 heavy agents per wave prevents context overflow. Wave naming (2A, 2B...) provides dependency ordering. Confirmed across 6 waves in MEGA EPIC Phase 2 with zero context overflow events.

Skill-creator first-pass success: providing exact markdown content + explicit size constraints (max 4KB/120 lines) in creator prompt produces correct under-budget artifacts first-pass. Zero oversizing in MEGA EPIC Phase 2.

Skill-catalog.md gap after creator workflow: skill-creator writes SKILL.md and skill-index.json entry but does NOT update skill-catalog.md. Manual doc update step gets skipped in Wave-based creation sessions. Mitigation: add post-creation catalog check to skill-creator workflow or artifact-integrator.

Headless CLI path resolution: when spawning CLI tools from cron/service contexts, use where/which auto-detection at startup. resolveClaude() runs where claude (Windows) or which claude (Unix), with CLAUDE_CLI_PATH env var fallback. Applied in telegram-claude-bridge.cjs commit e3ab739b. Anti-pattern: hard-coding the command string in spawn() calls for headless contexts.

MEGA EVOLUTION Wave 4 validation sequence: lint-fix (954 files) -> format (8627 files) -> validate (schema/config) -> agents:registry regenerate. This is the proven post-evolution quality gate sequence. lint scope < format scope because format also runs on generated/non-source files. Run in this exact order.

Parallel research batching for EPIC evolutions: Divide repositories into groups (A=4, B+C=2, D+E+F=6) and assign each group to a parallel researcher agent. Each group produces an action classification table: UPDATE vs CREATE. This reduces research time from sequential (N*30min) to max(group_time). Pattern confirmed in MEGA EVOLUTION v1 and v2 on 2026-03-14 and 2026-03-15.

Rules repositories as sources for rule creation: Before creating new rules (erlang-rules.md, zig-rules.md), check awesome-rules and cursorrules community repos for established best practices. These repos contain curated, community-validated patterns that outperform from-scratch rule authoring. Confirmed when creating erlang, zig, and observability rules in MEGA EVOLUTION v2 Wave 3.

Heartbeat loop registration pattern: Heartbeat-orchestrator successfully registers multiple heterogeneous cron loop patterns (email, telegram, webhook) in parallel. Loop structure is protocol-agnostic; state persistence ensures recovery across session restarts. CronCreate BEFORE CronDelete when rescheduling prevents duplicates. Validated with 8 concurrent loops in Task 12 (2026-03-16).
evidence: 8 loops operational, state recovery tested, multi-session persistence verified

text: Telegram Bot API polling protocol: store offset in .claude/context/tmp/telegram-offset.json, fetch getUpdates with offset, timeout=5, limit=10. Advance offset = last_update_id + 1. Never send partial/streaming replies — Telegram requires final-only responses. Confirmed working in Task 12 telegram polling heartbeat loop.
evidence: telegram polling loop operational in production heartbeat

text: Ecosystem bootstrap completion pattern: Init skill generates localized capability map identifying missing skills/agents for specific codebase. Bootstrap is a prerequisite for ecosystem-wide initialization workflows. Task bootstrap-init confirmed ecosystem initialization framework is operational and ready for distributed use.
evidence: init skill created, committed, integration verified

text: [BATCH-REFLECTION] Atomic Multi-File Commit Pattern (2026-03-21): Group related security fixes, phantom ref replacements, and sanitizer improvements into a single atomic commit. Validate with pre-commit hooks before committing. Evidence: commit 371bbf05 (29 files, all fixes, score 0.92). Area: git/devops

[BATCH-REFLECTION] Multi-Model Consensus Pattern (2026-03-21): Use Gemini + Codex consultation to validate prioritization of security findings. Cross-model agreement elevates issues from P1 to P0. Evidence: Task 15 multi-model review elevated MCP gap and memory sanitizer to P0/CRITICAL. Area: security/architecture

BMAD-Method comparison as external validation: cross-referencing framework against external AI methodology (BMAD-METHOD) surfaces architectural gaps invisible to self-referential internal audit. Applied in EPIC ecosystem audit 2026-03-21 — produced project-context.md for consistent AI agent behavior and confirmed 102-agent registry.

Destructive CLI safety pattern: always default to dry-run, require explicit --execute flag for destructive action, include age guard (min 2h) for recently-created resources, refuse deletion if resource has unique commits vs main. Reference: worktree-cleanup.cjs (590 lines, 2026-03-21 commit 9f3a9e3e).

Pre-release gate: always run validate:full AND confirm CHANGELOG completeness BEFORE cutting the version bump commit. v2.1.0 required 3 post-implementation REL-FIX commits (undocumented hooks, module-size baseline missing, CLAUDE.md Section 8 absent) because this gate was skipped. Saves N REL-FIX commits per release.

TDD red-green-cleanup commit structure for self-healing features: 1 regression test commit (RED) + 1 implementation commit (GREEN). Each feature has clear before/after boundary in git history. Apply consistently to all P0x/P1 self-healing deliverables in Phase 0.6.1 and beyond.

Session handoff commit practice: write the session handoff log as a final git commit (docs(handoff): ...) at every major milestone before session close. This preserves cross-session context in git history even if memory is lost or compressed. High-value for multi-session feature releases.

[CODE] TDD P01 (2026-04-20): Replace findProjectRoot() ancestor-walk with path.resolve(__dirname,'..','..','..') in hook files. CWD-relative root detection drifts when hooks run from .claude/.claude/ nested dirs. Evidence: bypass-audit-hook.cjs commit b90fb64f. Signal: presence of .claude/.claude/ double-prefix dir.

pnpm test (6200+ tests) consistently exceeds 120s default timeout. Always spawn QA agents with timeout:600000 (10min) and include pass-rate verification in post-run evidence before claiming release gate. Never accept a timed-out run as evidence of pass rate.

Agent refresh (agent-updater skill) does NOT automatically verify integration wiring. After each agent refresh cycle, run artifact-integrator to verify catalog presence, routing keywords, and agent-registry.json entries are current. Confirmed gap: reflection-agent and artifact-integrator refreshed 2026-04-17/18 but wiring unverified.

Dataflow audit pattern (task 3, 2026-04-24): End-to-end router→hooks→agents→skills→memory audit surfaces 7 class of integration gaps. Key categories: (1) agent registry/routing-table drift, (2) hook settings.json path mismatches, (3) hook stderr/stdout inversion (SE-03), (4) gap-log schema gaps (missing description field), (5) router tool-lockdown incomplete (mcp__* missing), (6) OWASP hook circuit-breaker absent, (7) SHA pinning absent in ingestion paths. Merge all findings into active_context.md for cross-session continuity.
